name: automem
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code via AutoMem (self-hosted FalkorDB + Qdrant). Remembers decisions, patterns, and preferences across sessions — with native graph relationships.

rest_base_url.title: AutoMem REST base URL (optional)
rest_base_url.description: Base URL of your self-hosted AutoMem instance, used by some hooks for direct REST pre-fetch (e.g. on file read, error capture). Example: https://automem.example.com. Leave empty to rely solely on MCP calls.

rest_auth_header.title: REST auth header value (optional)
rest_auth_header.description: Full Authorization header value used with rest_base_url. Example: 'Bearer xxx' or 'Token xxx'. Leave empty if rest_base_url is empty.
